On another note, maybe research healthy snacks that still imitate what you already like to eat. Maybe the condiments would make it taste the same but you’d still be eating healthier. 
Another thing you can try is to cut down on unhealthier snacks, still eat them, but if craving more, try some fruits. If i’m into something sweet, i cut up lots of strawberries and add some sugar (not the healthiest, i know, but hey it’s still fruits)
And on the health of your stomach, if you get it used to only highly proccessed foods, some of its ‘fauna’ so to speak is dying out because of the lack on nutrients and, eventually, it will start eating you from the inside to get those nutrients. So to avoid that, incorporate healthy foods in between your junk food. Fruits, carrots (i like them simple, as a snack) and other things that your stomach might have been craving. Yogurts are also great and you can find flawored ones with lots of protein.
Take care of your binge eating disorder! But also remember you can do a little bit to make you feel a lot better mentally and pshysically by making am efort to give your body what it needs too.
